description: F-CORE-024/SF-25 on the SHIPPED de pack: the appropriation of profit is a resolution, not a calculation, so summae never posts it on anyone's behalf — it arrives as an ordinary entry, `result_allocation` (2300) against retained earnings (2100), and the balance sheet moves the amount out of the result position into equity. Every other fixture for this proves the mechanism with a mapping of its own, which is exactly why the defect this fixture pins could hide: `de-bilanz` claimed 2000–2499 wholesale, swallowing 2300 next to 2100, so the two lines of the entry cancelled inside one position and the balance sheet did not move at all. A correctly booked resolution had no visible effect except a new zero row, and year 2027 kept reporting the 2026 result as its own `Jahresergebnis` — reported from an embedding application (its F-32) against 0.12.0. No year-end close here on purpose: `closeFiscalYear` is a pure status change without posting effect (pinned in `two-year-carryover`), so it would add twelve `closePeriod` steps and nothing to the statement. The reading to keep is the pair of balance sheets: as at 2026 the amount is the year's result, as at 2027 it is equity and the result position is zero — which is what a reader has to be able to tell apart.
